name: optcatalog_set_damage_mask_slot_index
description: OptCatalog::SetDamageMaskSlotIndex stores the active damage-mask texture slot index.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zModel/OptCatalog damage-mask provider pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x479c50 validates a direct store to g_OptCatalogDamageMaskSlotIndex.
The native smoke verifies the slot-index store before registering a damage-mask slot pointer.
